newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen down on economic concerns.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen down on economic concerns.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished down on Monday and dealers said the index was likely to edge lower on Tuesday amid concerns about an International Monetary Fund decision last week to suspend a standby loan.

"Speculations about how Pakistan will manage the economy without IMF support may keep the sentiment bearish unless the government comes up with a convincing plan of its own," an analyst at a foreign brokerage house said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 14.59 points, or 0.92 percent, to end at 1,578.16. Losers led gainers 157 to 133.
Turnover rose to 49 million shares from 36 million in the previous session on Friday.

Muslim Commercial Bank fell 0.50 to 36.50 rupees, Askari General Insurance 1.25 to 23.25, Cherat Cement 0.50 to 24.50, Pakistan State Oil 7.0 to 292, PTCL 0.10 to 29.80, Fauji Fertilizer 5.0 to 79 and Engro Chemicals 2.0 to 182.
